title: A joint resolution providing for the appointment of Risa Lavizzo-Mourey as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Appoints Risa Lavizzo-Mourey as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.

summary.headline: Congress approved a joint resolution appointing Risa Lavizzo-Mourey as a citizen regent of the Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents.
summary.what_it_does: This joint resolution names one person, Risa Lavizzo-Mourey, to serve as a citizen regent on the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution. The Smithsonian is a federal museum and research group, and its Board of Regents oversees it. The official summary says only that the measure makes this appointment and does not describe other changes.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The measure was enacted on February 21, 2014.
